label: rare late-original-phase step: q/z/t/i/s/c/k after o/r/i (sparse, unexplained)
explanation: Very sparse (0.004% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at positions 3-8, mostly near the end of the input (to_go 0-2) and in long sequences (L 7-9). It never fires at t<3, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (one exception). The input token is enriched for q/z/t/i/s/c/k, the previous token for o/r/i, and earlier inputs are often n/o/r/k/1. These conditions describe where it can fire, not whether it does: even the narrowest predicates were under 2.5% precise (best dev F1 0.044). The recorded predicate gets about 60% recall at 0.4% precision. Firing seems to depend on a specific hidden-state combination that token predicates do not capture. Magnitudes are tightly clustered (median 0.12, max 0.17), and I found nothing that clearly modulates them.
